title: GEN7-48990: AWS Integration- IP octets reversed in the auto created Address objects.
description: GEN7-48990: AWS Integration- IP octets reversed in the auto created Address objects.
result: IP octets should not be reversed in the auto created address objects.
steps:
When mapping auto-scaled EC2 instances to address groups. Instance name and IPs are correctly identified in the Profile Objects AWS page, but the created address objects have the IP octets reversed.

-AWS address object mapping is getting mapped successfully
-The objects were getting incorrectly populated.
-If a public IP assigned to an EC2 instance is 18.223.211.159, the corresponding address object in SonicWall shows it as 159.211.223.18.
-This reversed order applies to both public and private IPs associated with the instances.
-This incorrect order prevents proper network access for the auto-scaled EC2 instances.
-Manually correcting the IP order within the address object allows successful access to local network resources.
